name: Global Competitiveness Index (GCI)
description: A WEF annual assessment ranking 140+ countries on 98 indicators across 12 pillars including institutions, infrastructure, ICT adoption, macroeconomic stability, health, skills, and innovation.
reputation: Flagship WEF publication; widely cited by governments and investors; long time-series data.
notes: Mixed methodology (survey + hard data); paused after 2019 edition due to COVID disruption.
